title: Three Friends on Mountain Peak, 1956 Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid mid-1950s black-and-white snapshot depicting three young friends—two women and a man—standing together on a rocky mountain summit with a scenic vista in the background. They are casually dressed in typical 1950s outdoor attire, including a striped sleeveless top, casual button-up shirts, and high-waisted trousers. Etched into the rock at their feet are several names and dates including 'ELAINE', 'Phyllis', and '1956'. The right edge of the photo border bears a factory photo-finishing date stamp reading 'OCT 56'.
